verdict: eBay grew revenue 14% to $3.2B as the value of goods sold on its marketplace jumped 15%, but GAAP profit from continuing operations fell to $501M as spending on sales, product development and transaction losses rose faster than sales.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Revenue was $3,206M, vs $2,820M a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: From continuing operations, vs $1.27 a year ago; non-GAAP was $1.51

kpis.label: Gross merchandise volume
kpis.note: The value of goods sold on the platform, up 15% YoY

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: From continuing operations, after capital spending

segments.name: Marketplace revenues
segments.note: Fees eBay takes when items sell on its marketplace — its core business, including the Depop fashion marketplace bought in July.

segments.name: Advertising revenues
segments.note: What sellers pay to promote their listings — $575M of it from eBay's own first-party ad products, up 16%.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling and marketing the platform — the biggest running cost, up 23% YoY.

opex.name: Product development
opex.note: Building the marketplace, its AI listing tools and the eBay Live shopping experience — up 14% YoY.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company — finance, legal and admin — up 7% YoY.

opex.name: Transaction losses
opex.note: Money lost to fraud, chargebacks and buyer-protection claims on transactions — up 15% YoY.

opex.name: Amortization of acquired intangibles
opex.note: A non-cash charge spreading the cost of past acquisitions (such as brands and technology) over their useful lives.

otherDetail: Other was -$11M, net: $47M of interest income and other income, plus a $6M gain on equity investments and warrants, minus $64M of interest expense.
oneTimers: eBay completed its purchase of Depop, a consumer-to-consumer fashion marketplace, from Etsy on July 30, 2026 for $1.4B in cash — a balance-sheet deal this quarter, not a charge against profit.
Discontinued operations lost $4M in the quarter, so total GAAP net income was $497M versus the $501M from continuing operations used in this flow.
footerNote: The flow uses GAAP income from continuing operations ($501M), the figure eBay headlines; total GAAP net income was $497M after a $4M discontinued-operations loss. eBay reports a single operating segment — the split shown is net revenues by activity, from the Form 10-Q.

takeaways.title: Shoppers are spending more
takeaways.text: Gross merchandise volume — everything sold on the platform — rose 15% to $23.2B, and revenue rose 14% to $3,206M. Secondhand 'recommerce', live shopping and focus categories such as collectibles and car parts did the heavy lifting.

takeaways.title: Profit fell despite the growth
takeaways.text: GAAP profit from continuing operations fell 16% to $501M. Operating costs rose faster than sales — sales and marketing up 23%, product development up 14% and transaction losses up 15% — so the operating margin narrowed from 20.3% to 19.2%.

takeaways.title: Depop joins the family
takeaways.text: eBay closed its $1.4B cash purchase of Depop, the fashion resale app, on July 30. Even after deals and $689M of share buybacks, eBay still held $3.3B of cash and non-equity investments at quarter end.
